environment.harness: real QML NowPlayingBar + SignalTruthPopup, Python wall-clock and Qt event loop

truth.qt_quick_profiler_reason: the PySide6 runtime is not built with the QML debug service; qmlprofiler ignored -qmljsdebugger and the trace was damaged

notes: open_call_ms measures only the QML promotion dispatch on the owner thread and is effectively instant.
open_to_opened_ms includes the 200 ms fade-in token plus frame delivery; it is 16 ms above the 200 ms target.

The expansion harness alternated between sub-2 ms and 800 ms timeout samples because the reset of expandedStageId was not always observed before the next sample. The expansion p95 is therefore not certified.
No p95 value is inferred or invented; the raw sample list is retained in the KWin app log.
